headline: 13 contracts catalogued on Ethereum across core WISE, Wise Lending, and vault/peripheral categories; 1 deployer EOA and 1 team-funds recipient EOA surfaced; no multisig or timelock found.

D2: Official contracts page at https://docs.wise.one/contracts fetched and fully enumerated: WISE Token/Staking, Liquidity Transformer, Liquidity Guard, WISE/ETH Uniswap Pair, Signature Stakes, current USDC/USDT vaults (cross-chain via CREATE2), old Ethereum/Arbitrum USDC/USDT vaults, Original Power Farm, LiquidNFTs Router, LiquidNFTs ETH pool, Owl Town. WiseOracleHub and AaveHub listed with addresses. Total 13 named contract addresses on Ethereum. Wise Lending contracts also listed (WiseOracleHub, PositionNFTs, AaveHub, WiseSecurity, FeeManager) but PositionNFTs/WiseSecurity/FeeManager addresses not fully visible in search snippet — recorded as unknowns.

Audit predates current vault/lending deployments — addresses from audit may differ from live addresses.

D4: GitHub org wise-foundation has repos: wise-token-contracts (WISE Ethereum smart contracts), wise-token-contracts-bsc (BSC WISE), liquid-nfts-audit, wise-subgraph, wise-website-requests. No pinned deployment artifact files (broadcast/run-latest.json, deployments.json) were successfully fetched this run due to tool-call budget exhaustion. Recorded as unknown.

D5: protocol.chains lists only Ethereum. docs.wise.one/contracts also lists Arbitrum Network addresses for WiseOracleHub (0x5E93f02b629EfdCf889e544126167709206b92a8), USDC Vault (0x025421D3e98D3bB7A33d6814Dd576eD8B9090077), USDT Vault (0xD69670d0eCaF032Ea8b1A6925E59dBacAA20f43A, old), and current USDC/USDT vaults via CREATE2. protocol_metadata.about: Wise Token (WISE) is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum that allows users to stake WISE for a fixed period and earn interest proportional to their stake share, functioning similarly to a bond or certificate of deposit. The protocol launched via a 50-day Liquidity Transformer epoch in which users reserved WISE with ETH; at epoch close the contract deposited all ETH plus minted WISE into a Uniswap V2 pool and burned the LP tokens permanently, locking liquidity forever. The core staking contract has no owner, no admin keys, and is immutable; the wider Wise ecosystem also includes Wise Lending (isolated lending pools), ERC20 vaults for stablecoin yield backed by telecom RWA infrastructure via World Mobile, and LiquidNFTs. The Wise Foundation, an unincorporated nonprofit, funds and develops the ecosystem.
